name: 66053 · Louisburg, KS
findings: ZIP 66053 (Louisburg) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66053 (Louisburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 66053 (Louisburg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
